backend.name: postgres
backend.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg12+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit

machine.topology: one machine; the benchmark client, actor runtime, and Postgres container share its CPUs; database over loopback TCP

scenarios.name: progress
scenarios.description: Executor progress through the owner to a held connection: command to frame, and command to route broadcast with and without an opted-in member.
